lead.h: "It's good that young people have ideas": a newcomer's proposal gets fifty likes overnight
p: A proposal handed in by someone three days into the job was liked by everyone in the company group. The proposal was generated by an assistant. The newcomer says: "I only clicked once."
A human-resources expert calls it a good example of "letting young people be seen". Seen as what, the expert did not say.
